items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Houston. You got him? What'd he say? Houston. We got a big band there. Uh, his piano pair.

ctx.x: He means the steadiest job, right?

That is another fella. Ask him which band. Let me see what's his name. Houston. You got him? What'd he say? Houston. We got a big band there. Uh, his piano pair. He got Mercy and Cindy Desby and fellas. Mm-hmm.
Well, ask him which ones would, who had a slapstick, you know, to keep time good.
